## Scope and disposition

Add a proof-only edition of exactly two accepted local objections to Yuefeng Du, *Bipartite Exact Matching in P*, [arXiv:2604.01571v3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.01571v3), 9 April 2026.

- The actual four-row graph-cofactor family violates Theorem 4.4's final coprimality clause and Corollary 4.6(ii)'s valuation assertion. The factorization itself holds. No brace or index-1 patch realization is certified.
- The colored six-cycle refutes Proposition 2.3's independent target-sum decision inference under the standard brace convention. The two C4 contraction factors require the same original cut-edge identity when gluing. The source's malformed Hall+2 subset range is explicitly discussed.

The original target remains unresolved by this work. Neither exhibit is an ASNC counterexample. No disproof of deterministic polynomial-time Exact Matching, certification of a repaired algorithm, or Lean-kernel inconsistency is claimed. No formalization repository was accessed or built. No broader audit or remaining manuscript claim is certified. AI-assisted and unrefereed; no historical novelty, human peer review, or formal proof-assistant verification claim.

## Complete derivations and editorial preservation

AUDIT.md retains the complete written constructions, calculations, hypothesis checks, matching lists, compatibility proof, brace conventions, source pinpoints and limitations. Its mathematical Sections 1 and 2 are verbatim. The only changes adapt administrative framing to this standalone edition, remove an omitted-report identity and derived-text identities, and remove a superseded publication-history sentence. Public PDF identities and exact source pinpoints remain.

The other files provide a reading guide, narrow acceptance, provenance, public source metadata, scope/accounting, and a non-self-hashing inventory. No additional audit-frontier observation is included.

## Repository and accounting boundary

Exactly seven files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004914/`. No QUEUE.md, existing attempt, unrelated file, existing status or prior count changes. This editorial work adds no proof-search turn and does not reset accounting for duplicate 30004915 or related 3000034.

Only authored mathematical exposition, scoped acceptance and public verification metadata are included. No source copies or extractions, datasets, private material, scripts, fixtures or standalone checker outputs are included. No merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach.

## Preparation checks

The two raw public PDF copies were rehashed against the independent review. Mathematical-section byte preservation, the exact administrative editorial delta, UTF-8/JSON, relative links, manifest entries, exact path allowlist and excluded-material scan passed. The additive patch passed `git apply --check` and a clean temporary replay with exact file-byte matching. Ancestor Git trees were independently recomputed from the pinned base to preserve unrelated content. These are packaging checks, not additional mathematical certification. Remote readback and exact-head CI are separate post-publication checks; no CI pass is claimed here.

Base: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
